b: 1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder
1/2 each red, green and yellow bell pepper, sliced
Toss the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder, then coat in the flour.
Brown in the olive oil and butter over medium heat, 10 to 15 mins, till it hits 165. Pull it out.
Same pan, add the onion and peppers and saute about 10 mins till soft.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then deglaze with the white wine and scrape up the bottom.
Stir in the lemon juice and cream, put the chicken back and coat it in the sauce.
Simmer 5 mins and serve over angel hair.
